My Process

How I run
email campaigns.

Every campaign follows a proven 5-step framework — from strategy to results, nothing is left to chance.

1
Audit & Strategy
List health check, deliverability audit, competitive research, and full campaign strategy document
2
Segmentation
Audience segmentation by behavior, purchase history, engagement level, and geographic location
3
Design & Copy
Mobile-first email design, persuasive copywriting, A/B subject line variants, and CTA testing
4
Automation
Welcome sequences, abandoned cart flows, win-back campaigns, and post-purchase nurture
5
Report & Optimise
Open rate, click rate, revenue attribution analysis — continuous optimisation each send

Lifecycle planning

Email as the conversion layer—not an isolated newsletter.

The supplied Salescalator plan adds a practical lead-nurture use case: paid channels create and qualify demand, while email moves known prospects toward the next commercial action.

01 · Lead nurtureTier 3

Turn captured interest into a structured follow-up journey.

Leads from Search, LinkedIn, YouTube and Meta are segmented by behaviour and handed into a CRM-led email sequence designed to reduce conversion friction.

  • Source and intent-based segmentation
  • CRM handoff and lead-stage visibility
  • Message progression from education to action
02 · BehaviourSegmentation

Different follow-up for different website signals.

The strategy classifies bouncers, scrollers, browsers, CTA clickers and form quitters so each group receives a more relevant next message.

5Intent segments
1Connected CRM
3Funnel tiers
03 · Sequence logicAutomation

A clearer lifecycle from first touch to sales conversation.

  • Welcome and context after lead capture
  • Value-led education matched to the original offer
  • Proof, objection handling and decision support
  • Qualified CTA and sales handoff
Open complete lifecycle plan PDF ↗
04 · MeasurementOptimization

Track movement, not just opens.

Reporting focuses on progression through the funnel, CTA behaviour and which paid source produces the most useful leads.
